title: Zerobus Ingest into streaming tables is now generally available
body: Ingesting into [streaming tables](/aws/en/ldp/concepts/streaming-tables) with Zerobus Ingest in Lakeflow Connect is now generally available. Writing to a streaming table works the same way as writing to a managed Delta table, with the same limits and quotas. See [Create or identify the target table](/aws/en/ingestion/zerobus-ingest#create-or-identify-the-target-table).
